entries.note: UNSOLD (passed). Portrait of Willie Tjimba of the Pitjentjara Tribe, est $2,000-3,000, passed in

Sandhill Rhythm 1962 landscape, sold, price hidden
Simpsons Gap 1956 watercolour, sold, price hidden

Investigate carefully at viewing: confirm signature and 1957 date, whether it is watercolour or pastel/gouache, condition of the sheet and the old Alice Springs label (provenance value, entry to the Maude Vizard-Wholohan prize). 63 Battarbee lots on Invaluable, 29 watercolours sold or passed over 10 years with estimates mostly A$2,000-15,000; 2026 results (Deutscher and Hackett 27 Aug 2026 est $8-12k, Lawsons 22 Oct 2025 est $2-3k) show a firm market. Actual hammer prices are hidden by Invaluable; ask for them via Deutscher and Hackett / Lawsons results or artrecord. The A$250+ threshold looks easily cleared but no confirmed sold price was visible.
